concept_matrix.title: Missing, null, unavailable, and unknown identity states
Hidden, private, deleted, and edit-history unknowns

gap_register.description: ArtifactSnapshot cannot represent the retained diff, LICENSE, or acquisition envelope.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide whether v1 remains behind an outer envelope or follows an explicit versioned path
gap_register.title: ArtifactSnapshot media and envelope gap
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S08 must decide a compatibility boundary before exact non-JSON artifacts and acquisition provenance can be represented.

gap_register.description: Current SourceLocator has no revision-qualified byte-range identity.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide locator granularity and range semantics
gap_register.title: SourceLocator byte-range ambiguity
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S07 cannot identify bounded evidence without choosing revision-qualified range composition and digest linkage.

gap_register.description: Current SourceLocator cannot identify the bounded discussion surfaces.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide typed discussion identities and parent scope
gap_register.title: SourceLocator discussion-surface gap
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S07 must define typed parent-scoped discussion identities before bounded evidence can reference them.

gap_register.description: Complete historical provider state is not established beyond the current-visible bounded surfaces.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide a structured bounded-surface and unknown-history representation
gap_register.title: Current-visible provider surface only
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The future evidence carrier must retain this boundary without turning current-visible observations into a complete-history claim.

gap_register.description: Complete discussion edit and deletion history remains unknown.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: separately authorized historical evidence
gap_register.title: Discussion edit and deletion history unknown
gap_register.why_severity_applies: This is an evidentiary unknown to preserve, not an authorization to reacquire or reconstruct history.

gap_register.description: The historical repository default branch remains unknown.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: separately authorized historical ref evidence
gap_register.title: Historical default branch unknown
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The unknown must not be replaced with the repository's current default branch.

gap_register.description: The deleted head ref's original repository identity remains unknown.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: new evidence that directly identifies the historical head repository
gap_register.title: Original head repository identity unknown
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S06 cannot infer repository identity from the surviving immutable head SHA or deleted ref.

gap_register.description: Private and permission-hidden records remain unknown.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: separately authorized private-source evidence
gap_register.title: Private and permission-hidden records unknown
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The public case cannot support private-source completeness claims and no private acquisition is authorized.

gap_register.description: Mutable aliases and refs are observations and cannot serve as immutable identity.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide stable identity plus timed alias and ref observations
gap_register.title: Mutable aliases and ref observations
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Identity confusion follows if aliases or refs are treated as immutable object identity.

gap_register.description: The recorded PR base and merge first parent are distinct revisions.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide explicit revision roles and ordered-parent semantics
gap_register.title: Recorded base differs from merge first parent
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Collapsing the two revisions would corrupt topology and later causal interpretation.

gap_register.description: This public GitHub case supports no universal private-source or GitHub Enterprise claim.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: additional authorized provider and private-source evidence
gap_register.title: No universal private or GHE claims
gap_register.why_severity_applies: One public github.com case cannot justify a universal provider, private-source, or GitHub Enterprise contract.

gap_register.description: C01 actor and reviewer observations postdate the original S04 run and are not backdated.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide observation and publication provenance vocabulary
gap_register.title: Supplemental observations postdate original S04
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Future provenance must preserve observation and publication timing instead of silently backdating C01.

gap_register.description: Fresh supplemental actor and reviewer observations do not prove complete historical state.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: separately authorized historical attribution evidence
gap_register.title: Complete historical actor and review state not proven
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Fresh public observations remain bounded and cannot prove complete historical attribution.

gap_register.description: The supplemental actor field for Issue timeline source index 17 is observed null.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide actor identity and explicit missing-state vocabulary
gap_register.title: Issue timeline actor observed null
gap_register.why_severity_applies: A future identity contract must preserve observed null separately from omitted, unavailable, and unknown.

gap_register.description: All retained canonical URLs are authority-derived or deterministically constructed, not provider-returned fields.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide URL authority, construction, and observation provenance
gap_register.title: Canonical URLs not provider observed
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Authority-derived URLs must not be mislabeled as provider-returned evidence.

gap_register.description: Actor and reviewer fields absent from S04 remain absent; C01 supplements without rewriting S04.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide an append-only addendum and supersession boundary
gap_register.title: Original S04 actor and reviewer fields remain absent
gap_register.why_severity_applies: A compatibility carrier must add later observations without mutating or pretending to repair S04.

gap_register.description: The earlier procedural immutability nonconformance remains recorded.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: verify immutable S04 plus additive C01 plus derived S05/S06 topology
gap_register.title: Sealed-candidate nonconformance remains recorded
gap_register.why_severity_applies: P00 closure must preserve procedural nonconformance and the append-only precedence chain.

gap_register.description: Intentionally omitted original field values cannot be replayed after transient raw JSON cleanup.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: decide structured omission and retained-source boundaries
gap_register.title: Intentionally omitted original values are not replayable
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Future evidence must preserve explicit non-replayability without fabricating cleaned transient fields.

gap_register.description: The stale-cache explanation remains an unverified hypothesis, not established causation.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: direct causal evidence and later claim-review design
gap_register.title: Stale-cache causation unverified
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The correct state is an unverified hypothesis rather than a product defect cause or missing implementation.

gap_register.description: The case-local relationship vocabulary is provisional and internal.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: additional cases and explicit claim and relationship design
gap_register.title: Case relationship vocabulary provisional
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The case vocabulary is sufficient for literal testing but insufficient to establish a universal production relationship schema.

gap_register.description: Current SourceLocator and ArtifactSnapshot cannot represent the full case relationship and provenance layer.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: complete S07 identity decisions and decide the S08 evidence boundary
gap_register.title: Current internal models cannot represent full case
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S08 must decide how evidence, relationships, and provenance coexist with current provisional models before compatibility work proceeds.

gap_register.description: No FaultAtlas confidence model is defined by this case.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: multiple reviewed cases and an explicit confidence design
gap_register.title: Confidence model absent
gap_register.why_severity_applies: One case cannot calibrate a confidence model and S06 must not synthesize scores.

gap_register.description: No production FaultAtlas claim review-state model is defined.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: explicit claim-review lifecycle and multiple reviewed cases
gap_register.title: FaultAtlas claim review-state model absent
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Case-local reviewed labels do not authorize a production claim-review workflow.

gap_register.description: No production loader, migration, or persistence contract is defined.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: complete P00 decisions and deterministic corpus validation first
gap_register.title: Production loader, migration, and persistence absent
gap_register.why_severity_applies: These later implementation contracts are real but are outside S06 and depend on S07-S09 decisions and tests.

gap_register.description: No cross-repository pattern or transfer conclusion is established.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: additional reviewed cross-repository cases
gap_register.title: Cross-repository pattern and transfer not established
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The bounded invariant remains useful without claiming universal transfer.

gap_register.description: One case is insufficient to validate a universal schema.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: multiple diverse cases and later schema validation
gap_register.title: Single case insufficient for universal schema validation
gap_register.why_severity_applies: The matrix can calibrate current gaps without becoming a universal production schema.

gap_register.description: No production or tracked test-only reader validates the published S04, C01, S05, and S06 corpus layers as a linked deterministic set.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: S07 and S08 decisions recorded
gap_register.title: Test-only corpus reader and validator obligation
gap_register.why_severity_applies: S09 needs a bounded test-only verifier while production loader design remains deferred.

gap_register.description: Tracked tests do not yet independently assert exact IDs and order, endpoints, evidence pointers, controlled classifications, canonical bytes, sidecars, and recomputed summaries.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: stable S06 IDs and S07-S08 selected contracts
gap_register.title: Exact coverage, pointer, canonical, and sidecar replay tests
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Without independent deterministic replay, a superficially valid matrix can omit or contradict locked evidence.

gap_register.description: Current src-layout archives exclude the reference corpus, but no tracked corpus-specific regression test locks S06 filenames, matrix markers, and the historical pytest LICENSE exclusion.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: stable S06 artifact names and source markers
gap_register.title: Reference-corpus package exclusion regression proof
gap_register.why_severity_applies: A later packaging change could leak retained evidence into a wheel or source archive.

gap_register.description: S10 must reconcile docs, canonical JSON, derived Markdown, exact source locks, format versions, owner decisions, package exclusion, and clean synchronized publication state.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: S07-S08 decisions and S09 tests completed
gap_register.title: P00 closure consistency obligation
gap_register.why_severity_applies: P00 cannot close from narrative assertions if its machine-readable and publication evidence disagree.

gap_register.description: S10 must prove that S04 remains byte-identical, C01 remains additive, the recorded sealed-candidate nonconformance remains visible, and S05/S06 derive without rewriting prior layers.
gap_register.prerequisite_decision: S09 deterministic topology validation completed
gap_register.title: Append-only evidence topology closure
gap_register.why_severity_applies: Closure that normalizes away the correction history would destroy provenance and overstate evidence integrity.

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: SourceLocator remains alias-bound and object_id continues to admit incompatible scopes
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should provider, stable repository identity, timed aliases, object kind, repository-scoped numbers, global REST IDs, and GraphQL node IDs compose without ambiguity?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: attribution can silently collapse observed null into absent or unknown
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should actor and reviewer identities distinguish observed values, observed null, omitted, unavailable, inaccessible, and unknown?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: SHA-1 revision identity and SHA-256 artifact integrity remain string-shape ambiguous
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should commits, trees, blobs, comparison endpoints, and their hash algorithms be explicitly identified?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: bounded evidence and merge topology cannot migrate without losing role or lifecycle distinctions
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should ordered parents, distinct base and first-parent roles, mutable or deleted refs, revision-qualified paths, and line, byte, and hunk ranges compose?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: constructed URLs and later observations can be mislabeled as provider-returned or contemporaneous evidence
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should navigation authority, retrieval API authority, request provenance, URL construction provenance, observation time, and publication provenance compose?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: exact artifacts and acquisition provenance remain outside a decided compatibility path
owner_decision_register.exact_question: Should ArtifactSnapshot v1 remain unchanged behind an outer evidence envelope, evolve through an explicit version, or be replaced with an adapter?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: semantic JSON may be confused with retained provider bytes and digest scopes may be silently conflated
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should semantic normalized values, exact source bytes, requested and observed media, transformations, and algorithm-qualified digest scope be separated?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: free text and nullable booleans continue to lose evidentiary distinctions
owner_decision_register.exact_question: How should pagination, intentional omission, unavailable, deleted, inaccessible, observed null, current-visible limits, and unknown history be preserved?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: strict current payloads may break or correction history may be normalized away without a stated consumer path
owner_decision_register.exact_question: What semantic reader, canonical writer, version dispatch, migration, backward-compatibility, supersession, and append-only correction policy applies?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: S09 could accidentally create a premature production loader or fail to lock deterministic replay
owner_decision_register.exact_question: Which corpus checks belong in a bounded test-only verifier, and which production reader, loader, or migration behaviors remain explicitly out of scope?

owner_decision_register.consequence_of_deferral: P00 could be declared complete while artifacts, decisions, tests, or publication state disagree
owner_decision_register.exact_question: What exact evidence proves P00 closure across decisions, deterministic tests, source locks, append-only topology, package exclusion, docs, publication, and clean synchronization?

items.stable_decision_or_requirement_being_pul: typed provider stable repository alias scoped/global and missing-state distinctions
algorithm-qualified revisions ordered parents mutable refs and revision-qualified ranges
separate semantic JSON exact bytes media observations digest scope and provenance
reader writer version migration and backward-compatibility acceptance requirements
canonical bytes sidecars exact input locks and deterministic repeat serialization tests
entity relationship pointer classification owner and summary integrity tests
tree clean sync immutable locks package exclusion compatibility and decision settlement checklist

implement an Evidence Envelope in S08 preparation
turn the case or matrix format into a universal production schema
choose database persistence graph vector or model vendor
add ingestion retrieval embeddings synthesis or RAG
add comprehensive corpus tests during S06
